gloss_en: livelihood earned in sorrow/toil (parnasah she-hu be-itzavon) — sustenance pursued with anxious grief, echoing the curse 'be-itzavon tokhelenah' (Gen 3:17), the bitter unrectified mode of earning a living, likened to 'more bitter than death is the woman' (Eccl 7:26), opposed to livelihood of holiness
